svg.title: Positive rotations about the x, y, and z axes
svg.desc: A cube and a right-handed coordinate frame share one orthographic projection. Terracotta, green, and ochre arcs are projections of circles centered at the origin in the yz, xz, and xy planes, respectively. Their arrows follow positive rotation about the matching x, y, and z axes. Dashed portions are behind the origin; the cube occludes hidden portions. This illustrates spatial rotations, not the shape of SO(3).
svg.metadata: Generated by artwork/generate_spatial_rotation.py. Camera: azimuth 45 degrees, elevation 30 degrees. For each of the three arcs, dp/dtheta = n cross p. Cube half-side 0.4; x, y, z circle radii 1.02, 1.03, 1.04.
